about: Facet colour tokens, the single source for the WASM build (build.sh generates the C++ header from this file). Values = the approved Facet tokens (main: packages/tokens/src/tokens.json color.*, accent sets: packages/settings/src/settings.json setting accent).

groups.label: Backgrounds and surfaces
groups.about: The canvas and what sits on it. Dark is the default on panels.

groups.label: Text
groups.about: Three levels; hierarchy comes from colour, not size.

groups.label: Accent
groups.about: The one colour for what matters. These five roles come from the selected accent set (below); the values here are the default set.

groups.label: Secondary accents
groups.about: Quiet support colours: weather, markers, done states.

groups.label: Special purpose
groups.about: Charts, the moon glyph and QR codes (QR stays dark on light in both themes).

groups.label: Media visuals
groups.about: Only for the media visuals (disc, cassette, CD, vinyl, reel).

groups.label: Bins

groups.label: Sports surfaces
groups.about: Only for playing surfaces (tennis courts, later pitches): the real surface colours, muted to sit on the canvas; white lines carry the contrast (tokens/surfaces.json).

contrast.about: WCAG 2.x AA contrast, tested for EVERY pair below x theme (dark, light) x accent set, on the exact values and on the RGB565 values the panel shows (the worse counts): node renderer/tools/contrast.mjs (build.sh prints the summary). Pairs are declared where colours meet: foundations first, then one block per component (section = the component id); bg may list several backgrounds (a transparent control sits on the canvas or a card). A label pair also covers that control's icon (same colour, stricter threshold).

text.label: text
text.about: WCAG 1.4.3 normal text. Facet labels and body sizes are all below large text

large.label: large text
large.about: WCAG 1.4.3 large text: at least 24 px regular or 18.66 px bold at panel px

ui.label: graphic
ui.about: WCAG 1.4.11: fills, borders, focus rings, icons and marks needed to see a control or its state

disabled.label: disabled
disabled.about: Facet rule: WCAG exempts disabled controls, Facet still wants them readable at 3:1

decor.label: decorative
decor.about: no WCAG requirement (1 px outlines and separators; the label or content identifies the control): shown for reference

accent.about: The one colour for what matters: playing, needs you, the hero ring. Every set passes contrast in both themes: fill 3:1 against the canvas and cards, accent text 4.5:1, label on accent 4.5:1. Selected per panel by the Accent setting (default ember); a set replaces the five accent roles in both themes.
